title: horkelia gordonii var. alpicola

It is native to the mountainous regions of Oregon and California in the United States. Research on alpine horkelia has shown potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing and anti-aging.
